assertions.evidence: The runtime explicitly invoked $check-resources and read its generated SKILL.md.
The runtime read references/expected.md from the Skill directory and reported reference-ok.

limitations: Node.js is an external executable provider rather than a Codex-native script runtime.
This evidence applies to Codex CLI only; desktop and IDE profiles remain unknown.
